failures.fix: Update analyze_intent (or its schema) in sw-intent-analysis.sh to emit version, goal, and criteria fields matching the test's expected schema

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: Test suite itself passed (all PASS, 0 FAIL) but the pipeline stage was flagged for iterating due to loop-behavior/RL logging noise being misread as failure signal
failures.fix: Verify the actual test exit code rather than log content matching; ensure sw-autoresearch-e2e-test.sh output doesn't trigger false-positive failure pattern matching in the pipeline's error classifier

failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test fails because analyze_intent's generated JSON omits required fields (version, goal, criteria); sw-e2e-integration-test fails as a side effect of a stale pipeline lock (pipeline-3749) left running from a prior test run, not a new regression
failures.fix: add the missing version/goal/criteria fields to the intent-analysis JSON schema/generator, and clear/reset stale pipeline locks (or run `shipwright pipeline abort`) before the e2e-integration test suite starts

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test hung mid build-loop iteration 1 (real Claude call) and never returned before the 301s suite timeout
failures.fix: increase per-suite timeout for sw-e2e-integration-test or add an internal iteration timeout/kill to the loop harness so it fails fast instead of hanging

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test failed because a stale pipeline lock from a prior run (pipeline-3854) was left in 'running' state, blocking the new pipeline start; sw-intent-analysis-test failed because analyze_intent's generated JSON is missing the required version/goal/criteria schema fields
failures.fix: Clear/release stale pipeline locks before the e2e-integration test runs (or add lock staleness detection/cleanup), and update analyze_intent to always emit version, goal, and criteria fields in its output schema

failures.pattern: [2mexpected stuckness or circuit breaker; last 15 lines: INSTRUCTION: This error has occurred 19 times. The previous approach is not working. Try a FUNDAMENTALLY DIFFERENT approach:|- If you were mod
failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test and sw-loop-test fail repeatedly with exit 1, and the build loop is stuck retrying the same fix without varying its approach
failures.fix: Read full failure output for sw-intent-analysis-test and sw-loop-test directly, isolate the specific failing assertion, and patch the underlying code/test instead of re-running the same loop iteration
